scope: Follow-up local working-tree audit and isolated synthetic production build; no deployment or live account mutation

confirmed_findings.finding: Old account remained visible until the deferred SDK verification timer; an old read could settle in that gap.
confirmed_findings.correction: Credential events synchronously abort and fence old reads; different owners clear immediately.
confirmed_findings.evidence: New old-owner-before-next-timer DOM assertion failed on the prior implementation and passes after the change.

confirmed_findings.finding: PKCE exchange shared unrelated data-query circuit/rate limits and lacked an overall deadline.
confirmed_findings.correction: Request-scoped uncached exchange under ten seconds; direct cookie-bearing redirect; no automatic mutation replay.

confirmed_findings.finding: Entry middleware refreshed old credentials before callback or explicit recovery; it overwrote the callback no-referrer policy.
confirmed_findings.correction: Exact login/signup/callback middleware bypasses old-account refresh; callback handler and middleware agree on no-referrer.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Raw compiled HTTP exposed the referrer-policy override after route tests passed; final compiled checks pass.

confirmed_findings.finding: Persisted history restoration lacked forced verification and could miss cross-tab logout markers.
confirmed_findings.correction: Cancel reads on persisted pagehide; recheck markers and verify on pageshow, retaining the requirement while hidden.

confirmed_findings.finding: Failed focus verification did not update the freshness clock, allowing repeated focus events to amplify outages.
confirmed_findings.correction: Thirty-second focus/visibility cooldown from the last attempt; actual offline recovery can recheck immediately.

confirmed_findings.finding: SDK SIGNED_OUT after failed server revocation could remove the explicit failed-sign-out recovery state.
confirmed_findings.correction: Pending revocation retains signout_failed until explicit server-confirmed completion.

checks.includes: 4 callback/middleware tests, existing revocation and adversarial identity contracts

cases: late response and SDK event after failed sign-out
